name: animatrix-monorepo
description: Linux control for the ASUS ROG AniMe Matrix: library, daemon, CLI and tray app

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/animatrix packages/effects packages/daemon packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/animatrix packages/effects packages/daemon packages/cli && pnpm -C apps/tray typecheck
